# IronLog — Free, No-Login Workout Tracker

> 100% local-first PWA. No account. No ads. Open source (MIT).

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://ironlog-pwa-1ls.pages.dev/): Main workout tracker app
- [Exercise Library](https://ironlog-pwa-1ls.pages.dev/exercises/): 57+ exercises with GIFs & instructions
- [Training Programs](https://ironlog-pwa-1ls.pages.dev/store/): Premium templates (one-time purchase)
- [Guides](https://ironlog-pwa-1ls.pages.dev/guides/): Workout tips & how-tos
- [Pain Points](https://ironlog-pwa-1ls.pages.dev/pain-points/): Common workout tracking problems solved

## About
IronLog stores all workout data in your browser's localStorage. No backend, no database, no tracking scripts. CSV export, PWA offline support, installable to home screen. Premium templates via Gumroad — lifetime access, no subscription.
